posts.title: Luxembourg's new passport: late, stuck at the gate, and wanted by Washington
posts.description: Seven years of parliamentary questions on the Luxembourg passport: a ten-year passport that arrived years late, chips that some border gates cannot read, and a US push for Europeans' biometric data.

posts.title: Cross-Border Remote Work: The Hidden Challenge
posts.description: French cross-border workers are drifting to Paris employers that offer unlimited remote work. Why Luxembourg needs higher telework thresholds, shared tax models and a Greater Region framework to stay attractive.

posts.title: Beyond Banking: Luxembourg's next financial evolution
posts.description: Examining Luxembourg's fintech potential: why our financial center must shift from traditional banking excellence to leading financial innovation, drawing from global insights and local advantages.
